newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Feb 24.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Feb 24.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Bunker prices fell in thin trade in line with a $2.00 per tonne drop in cargo prices. Traders said shipowners were not taking up incremental volumes on expectations of further price cuts. Traders said prices in South Korea were still below Singapore. Sources said an independent sold 380-cst at $98 and $99 per tonne with a major selling one lot at $101.00.
